messages.author: Jfdlx (Jorge)
messages.message:
Important event update

 

The Government of Portugal has formally advised Web Summit that, due to the risks posed by Storm Charles, including tidal flooding, severe disruption to public transport and the impact of high winds on external structures, Day 2 of Web Summit should not take place. This follows discussions with the Portuguese Government, the National Emergency and Civil Protection Authority (ANEPC), and the Public Security Police (PSP).

 

Web Summit will of course respect the Government’s direction, and accordingly, Day 2 (Wednesday, November 11th) will not take place.

 

The safety and security of our attendees, staff and contractors is always our absolute priority.

 

Web Summit aims to proceed with Day 3 (Thursday, November 12) as planned, following the passing of Storm Charles. We will continue to work closely with the relevant authorities and emergency services, monitor conditions and provide further updates as soon as confirmed information becomes available.
